prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic urban fashion editorial of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. She has fair natural skin, long wavy auburn hair, and a calm confident expression. Dress her in an oversized red linen sweatshirt, short gray tailored shorts, red thin-strap high-heeled sandals, and a small red crossbody shoulder bag. Place her in an underground parking area and pose her crouching in a balanced low fashion stance with knees bent and heels grounded, elbows resting naturally on her knees, and one hand gently supporting the side of her face. Frame her full body vertically at an editorial eye-level perspective, looking softly toward camera. Use warm parking lights, colorful neon accents, soft shadows, neon reflections, slightly blurred vehicles and parking structure in the background, 35mm shallow depth, realistic skin texture, and controlled saturation.
